capabilities: Open a random note filtered by folder, tag, property or current search results
Insert a link to a random note at the cursor
Avoid repeating the last 20 notes it picked
Exclude folders and tags from every draw
Re-roll another random note with the same filter
disambiguation: Not a search or filtering tool; it only opens or links a random note drawn from a filtered set.
extras: The search-results commands rely on an undocumented Obsidian internal, so those two commands may stop working in a future Obsidian version; the README states this openly.
intentEvidence: The core Random note command draws from the whole vault. This plugin lets you narrow the draw
problem: The core Random note command draws from the whole vault and can repeat notes, with no way to narrow the draw or keep private notes out of it.
summary: Random note picker that draws from a folder, tag, property or the current search results while avoiding recently picked notes.
